hook.name: AproFunLaunchpadFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-sensitive fee hook for AproFun Launchpad pools that charges 1–7% ETH fees on every swap, scaled dynamically by the tick movement of the previous swap. Buy fees are taken from the ETH input in beforeSwap; sell fees from the ETH output in afterSwap. Pool initialization is restricted to the bound factory contract only.
